title: Score (format 1)
description: A piece of music as data: notes on a tick timeline (480 ticks to the quarter note), tracks, and the tempo, meter and key maps and repeat marks that say how it is read. Ticks are authoritative; seconds are derived through the tempo map (docs/design/score.md, "Interchange"). Modelled on music-studio's Score (src/core/model/types.ts). Unknown fields are ignored by readers and kept by writers that round-trip. Limits below are the schema's bounds; a reader may be stricter.

version.description: The format. Bumped only by a change an old reader would misread; added optional fields do not bump it.

ppq.description: Ticks per quarter note. Fixed at 480: 1 eighth = 240, 1 sixteenth = 120, a triplet eighth = 160. Another resolution is converted on import (SMF files state their own division).

bpm.description: Quarter notes a minute at tick 0. A tempoChanges entry at tick 0 overrides it, so the two cannot disagree.

keySignature.description: The key at measure 0, in fifths: +n sharps, -n flats.

measures.description: How many measures the written grid shows. A reader takes the larger of this and what the notes need.

tempoChanges.description: Tempo after the start, by tick. A step function: each tempo holds until the next change (no accelerando). Order does not matter; a reader sorts, and a second change at one tick wins.

meterChanges.description: Meter changes by 0-based measure, never by tick: a meter taking effect mid-bar is not notatable.

keyChanges.description: Key changes by 0-based measure. A key change moves no barlines; it changes spelling and the signature drawn.

repeats.description: Repeat signs and volta brackets, stated as marks on barlines (what notation and MusicXML state), not as a play order. The play order is derived (docs/design/score.md, "Repeats").

tracks.description: Instruments (parts), not clip lanes. A grand-staff instrument is one track with staffCount 2.

patches.description: Synth patches the tracks point at by instrumentId ("patch:<id>"), carried in the score so a shared score is self-contained. Their shape belongs to the audio side (viaframe's DSP patch or music-studio's SynthPatch) and is not constrained here.

buses.description: Shared send buses (music-studio: at most 4). Shape owned by the effects rack; not constrained here.

tick.description: A position or length in ticks (480 to the quarter note).

bpm.description: music-studio clamps and rounds to a whole number from 20 to 300; a reader may do the same.

timeSignature.description: "num/den", e.g. "4/4", "6/8". A measure is num x (4 / den) quarter notes: round(that x 480) ticks.

repeatMark.description: Marks on one measure's barlines. One measure may carry several at once (a first ending closes with a repeat sign on the same barline).

start.description: A repeat sign on the measure's LEFT barline: play from here again.

end.description: A repeat sign on the RIGHT barline.

times.description: How many times the section is played in TOTAL: 2 means play it twice.

ending.description: A volta bracket beginning at this measure.

numbers.description: The passes it is played on: [1] a first ending, [2, 3] one bracket shared by two passes.

stop.description: Closes the bracket at this measure's right barline.

note.description: The first five fields are all playback needs. The rest are notation-only (they never change what is heard) and may be absent: absent means derive it.

id.description: Unique within the score; edits address notes by it.

pitch.description: MIDI note number, 60 = C4 = middle C. music-studio's editor stays inside 12..107.

accidental.description: Enharmonic override; absent spells from the key (music-studio score/pitch.ts Accidental).

tuplet.description: { num: 3, den: 2 } is a triplet. Notation only: the note's ticks already say how long it sounds.

rest.description: An explicit rest. Gaps between notes are filled automatically, so most rests have no object.

instrumentId.description: A pointer, not a definition: a General MIDI preset id, "patch:<id>" into the score's patches, or "sample:<id>" into the host's own sample store. A reader that cannot resolve it falls back to a stock voice and says so.

effects.description: Insert effects in order. Shape owned by the effects rack; not constrained here.

hidden.description: Hidden from editors, independent of muted.
